services.name: Waterski
services.desc: Whether you are experienced or just a beginner to say you have water skied in Hawaii is a must! Our trained staff will take you on the protected waters of our inland marina and provide you with the experience of a lifetime. Our boats are top of the line Ski Nautiques which will allow you to enjoy your time on the warm waters in total comfort. Participants must be 12 years or older. services.name: Banana Boat Ride
services.desc: The Banana Boat ride is definitely the activity you don’t want to miss out on! Duration 20 minutes About Jump on our six person inflatable boat and have more fun than you ever imagined. You will ride out from the dock to the marina in our luxury ski nautique and then transfer to the Banana Boat. The Ski Nautique skippered by our USCG Certified Captain will tow you through the marina where you will hang on and try desperately not to fall off.
